PROJECT(SHELL)

add_subdirectory(shellbars)
add_subdirectory(shellfind)

spec2def(browseui.dll browseui.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# browseui.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/browseui-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(browseui_shims OBJECT ACLCustomMRU.cpp aclhistory.cpp aclistisf.cpp aclmulti.cpp addressband.cpp addresseditbox.cpp bandproxy.cpp basebarsite.cpp brandband.cpp browseui.cpp browseuiord.cpp CAutoComplete.cpp CShellTaskScheduler.cpp CTaskbarList.cpp commonbrowser.cpp desktopipc.cpp globalfoldersettings.cpp internettoolbar.cpp parsecmdline.cpp regtreeoptions.cpp settings.cpp shellbrowser.cpp toolsband.cpp travellog.cpp CProgressDialog.cpp CUserAssist.cpp dllinstall.c)
target_link_libraries(browseui_shims PRIVATE shellbars shellfind uuid wine cpprt atl_classes libuxtheme libshdocvw libshlwapi libshell32 libcomctl32 libgdi32 libole32 liboleaut32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libmpr libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(browseui_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_compile_options(browseui_shims PRIVATE -Wno-unused-but-set-variable)
endif()
add_cargo_module(browseui browseui-cargo browseui.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS browseui_shims psdk uuid_sources xdk shellbars shellfind)
add_custom_command(TARGET browseui POST_BUILD
  COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy
     "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/browseui.dll"
     "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/base/shell/filebrowser/browseui.dll"
  COMMENT "Copying to output directory")
